method: One primary planning root per source ID; secondary causal links belong in architecture document. Historical fixed IDs remain as regression evidence, not new defects. v0.15 outcomes are recorded separately in v015_disposition; original status fields remain the planning-baseline review state.

roots.v015_disposition: Implemented in v0.15: private-only admission requires private-chat evidence and an enabled provider; group control and implicit credential-based activation are rejected. Local source and behavior checks pass; live provider/device evidence remains unknown.

Implemented in v0.15: authorization and current-task ownership use explicit (channel, accountId, userId) tuples without a default-account fallback. Local isolation and fault checks pass; live provider identity evidence remains unknown.

Implemented in v0.15: approval, question, action and private-control transitions use durable authorities and exact source/account checks. Local race and fault suites pass; live Host/provider interaction evidence remains unknown.

Implemented in v0.15: Native projections/actions use bounded, redacted views; the standalone Admin Console is removed. Local DOM and contract checks pass; a fresh real DSH Host walkthrough remains unknown.

Implemented in v0.15: account-scoped task routing and canonical configuration are retained; legacy config overlays and automatic conversion are removed. The guessed dsh-im one-click importer is explicitly skipped at the user’s direction.

Implemented in v0.15: runtime generations, post-commit observation gaps and delivery evidence distinguish accepted, confirmed, unknown and failed outcomes. Local lifecycle tests pass; real provider receipts remain unknown.

Implemented in v0.15: shared writes use durable transaction boundaries and explicit failure results; pre-v0.15 state is backed up then reset without conversion. Local disk, concurrency and recovery tests pass.

Implemented in v0.15: Cloud deployment jobs persist checkpoints and recover by readback; external retry requires an explicit user action. Local fault matrix passes; real Cloud account effects remain unknown.
Implemented and locally checked in v0.15: tunnel lifecycle stays under the supervisor and Native action authority. A real Cloudflare account/tunnel run remains unknown.
Implemented in v0.15: provider-specific private-chat normalization and group rejection are covered by local protocol tests. Real provider/device behavior remains unknown.
Implemented in v0.15: public notifier API 0.8 and the checked DSH Host/dsh-im source contracts have fixed-source/interface tests. These tests do not prove real Host boot or provider delivery.

Implemented in v0.15: the standalone recovery listener and obsolete launch surface are removed; Native uses the admitted Host connection and old state remains offline-only. Real Host boot evidence remains unknown.

Local release evidence is recorded in PROGRESS.md and must match the final gate run. Remote push is attempted only on dev; real Host/provider/device/Cloud evidence remains unknown and no release/publish is claimed.

deep.title: dsh-im v1 checked contract 的 fingerprint 字段读错，真实 bridge 会把支持 bot 判成“不支持”
deep.body:
## DSH-F01 — P1 — dsh-im v1 checked contract 的 fingerprint 字段读错，真实 bridge 会把支持 bot 判成“不支持”

当前 notifier：

[`src/control-plane/dsh-im-bridge.mjs`](https://github.com/THEWOLFWALKER/dsh-notifier/blob/2542a3107e7d3795e6ba5b294a7a5b82052c3431/src/control-plane/dsh-im-bridge.mjs)

`botProjection()` 读取：

```js
const accountFingerprint = str(
  description?.accountFingerprint ?? description?.fingerprint
)
```

并据此判断：

```js
checked =
  accountFingerprint !== null
  && capabilities.includes('proactive-text-checked')
```

但当前 dsh-im `4.34.2` 的真实 contract v1 返回的是：

```js
{
  version: 1,
  botId,
  channel,
  connected,
  capabilities: ['proactive-text-checked'],
  account: {
    fingerprint
  }
}
```

dsh-im 自己的 `sendChecked()` 也明确校验：

```js
if (account.account?.fingerprint !== expectedFingerprint)
  throw deliveryError('account-changed')
```

证据：

- [dsh-im delivery-service.mjs](https://github.com/xmanrui/dsh-im/blob/ecf6c85b72b213bcc937e379cf125d210d447401/plugin-src/host/delivery-service.mjs)
- [dsh-im PROACTIVE_DELIVERY.md](https://github.com/xmanrui/dsh-im/blob/ecf6c85b72b213bcc937e379cf125d210d447401/PROACTIVE_DELIVERY.md)

真实 dsh-im service 的 `description.account.fingerprint` 有值，但 notifier 读取的两个字段都是 `undefined`，所以 `checked=false`。随后 `listTargets()` / `send()` 都会把真实支持 checked delivery 的 bot 当成 `not-supported`。

---

deep.title: Cloudflare Telegram 使用 YAML-only token 时，`secretReference` 会在 claim 落盘后把自己的 token 来源切断
deep.body:
## DSH-F03 — P1 — Cloudflare Telegram 使用 YAML-only token 时，`secretReference` 会在 claim 落盘后把自己的 token 来源切断

当前：

[`src/cloudflare/deployment.mjs`](https://github.com/THEWOLFWALKER/dsh-notifier/blob/2542a3107e7d3795e6ba5b294a7a5b82052c3431/src/cloudflare/deployment.mjs)

token 读取：

```js
const token = () => {
  const ref = store.get('cloudflare:deployment:telegram')?.secretReference
  return String(
    (ref ? store.get(ref)?.botToken
         : outboundConfig.raw('telegram')?.botToken) ?? ''
  ).trim()
}
```

首次 `deploy()` 会先从 `outboundConfig.raw('telegram')` 读到 YAML token；但 claim 持久化后：

```js
record.secretReference =
  payload.botToken
    ? 'telegram:account'
    : (previous?.secretReference ?? 'channel:telegram:outbound')
```

YAML-only 场景没有 `channel:telegram:outbound` state row，下一次 `token()` 因为已经有 ref，就不再 fallback 到 `outboundConfig.raw()`，直接得到空串。

而同一轮 deployment 后面马上比较：

```js
fingerprint(currentToken) !== current.configSecretGeneration
```

所以这个问题可在**同一次部署**里触发，不需要等重启。

现有 Cloudflare test rig 的 `yamlRows` 是空 Map，没有覆盖 YAML-only token。

deep.title: Cloudflare durable job 没有实际 `failed` 终态，永久错误被永久标成 `recovery-required`
deep.body:
## DSH-F04 — P1 — Cloudflare durable job 没有实际 `failed` 终态，永久错误被永久标成 `recovery-required`

代码多处把 terminal 定义为：

```text
done
failed
cancel-requested
```

但当前 deployment service 没有任何一处写：

```js
state: 'failed'
```

所有 durable exception，只要不是显式 cancel，都进入：

```js
state: 'recovery-required'
recoveryRequired: true
```

包括确定性本地冲突，例如 credential generation mismatch / bad-request / conflict。

因此“可恢复的不确定云状态”和“确定永久失败”没有被状态机真正分开。

deep.title: Cloudflare 永久失败 job 可形成不可取消的 retry livelock
deep.body:
## DSH-F05 — P1 — Cloudflare 永久失败 job 可形成不可取消的 retry livelock

`deploy()` 会优先找任何非 terminal job：

```js
if (pending) return resume(pending)
```

所以 durable `recovery-required` 会被每次重试继续 resume。

但公开 `cancel()` 只处理当前内存 `job`。当一次失败已经 settle 后：

```text
job = null
durable row = recovery-required
```

此时 cancel 不会改 durable row。下一次 deploy 又会把同一 row 捞回来。

如果失败原因是永久性的，例如 secret generation 已变化，就会形成同一 durable claim 的重复冲突循环。
